title: FIRM: Fisher-Informed Retention Merging for Federated LLM Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2610.21720v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated LLM unlearning addresses targeted knowledge removal when forget and retain data remain distributed across private clients and are inaccessible to the server. The resulting locally trained adapters encode conflicting objectives, making their aggregation fundamentally different from conventional federated optimization. A key failure mode is magnitude explosion, whereby unnormalized cross-client aggregation increases the merged update magnitude and degrades retained utility under stronger unlearning. We propose FIRM (Fisher-Informed Retention Merging), a single-round framework for stable and retention-aware server-side aggregation. FIRM uses client-local Fisher statistics as a unified sensitivity signal to construct a Fisher-normalized base merge and impose explicit control over retain-sensitive parameters. Its second-order retention projection admits a unique minimum-distance solution, while the corresponding dual scales with t

translated_title: FIRM：面向联邦大语言模型遗忘的Fisher信息驱动的保留感知合并
translated_abstract: 联邦大语言模型遗忘旨在解决当遗忘数据与保留数据仍分布在各个私有客户端上、服务器无法访问时的定向知识移除问题。由此产生的本地训练适配器编码了相互冲突的目标，使其聚合与传统的联邦优化有本质区别。一个关键的失效模式是幅度爆炸，即未经归一化的跨客户端聚合会增大合并后更新的幅度，并在更强的遗忘过程中损害保留效用。我们提出FIRM（Fisher-Informed Retention Merging，Fisher信息驱动的保留感知合并），这是一个用于稳定且保留感知的服务器端聚合的单轮框架。FIRM利用客户端本地的Fisher统计量作为统一的敏感度信号，构建Fisher归一化的基础合并，并对保留敏感参数施加显式控制。其二阶保留投影具有唯一的最小距离解，而相应的对偶变量随t…（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出FIRM框架，利用客户端本地Fisher统计量进行归一化合并并对保留敏感参数施加显式控制，解决联邦大语言模型遗忘中的幅度爆炸问题，在单轮服务器端聚合中实现稳定遗忘与保留效用的兼顾。
en_tdlr: FIRM proposes a single-round, Fisher-informed retention merging framework that uses client-local Fisher statistics for normalized aggregation with explicit control over retain-sensitive parameters, mitigating magnitude explosion in federated LLM unlearning while preserving retained utility.
